name: heavy-study-month
description: A month of dense study notes. Tests that depth is matched without lecturing.

notes.title: Psalm 27 structure
notes.text: Verses 1-6 confident, 7-12 pleading, 13-14 resolve. The hinge at 7 is abrupt. Is this two psalms stitched?

notes.title: Hebrew: dwell
notes.text: The word in 27:4 keeps coming back. Sitting, remaining, not visiting.

notes.title: Cross refs
notes.text: Ps 23:6 and Ps 84 both circle the same idea of a house one stays in.

notes.title: Question
notes.text: Why is waiting the last word rather than arrival?
